verdict.rationale: Automatic retry of failed payments is a fair question for invoicing and billing software, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows automated payment reminders and stored-card auto-charging for recurring transactions. Neither documents retrying failed charges on an ML- or schedule-optimized cadence, or measuring recovered involuntary churn.

support.subject: As a finance lead, failed renewal payments are retried automatically on an ML- or schedule-optimized cadence that measurably recovers involuntary churn
